title: Microsoft Teams: collaborative meeting notes saved to the meeting organiser's OneDrive
summary: The briefing accurately reports the automatic storage change, the rollout window and the existing licensing and controls. Its governance checklist names retention, hold and discovery controls that are missing from the controls table; this is a minor completeness finding.

claims.claim: This is Microsoft Teams roadmap item 576194 about organiser-owned meeting notes.
claims.quote: "id": 576194; "title": "Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive"

claims.claim: Non-channel meeting notes move from the note-starter's OneDrive to the meeting organiser's OneDrive for Business.
claims.quote: will be stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive for Business instead of the OneDrive of the person who starts the notes.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope: Notes covered
claims.claim: The storage change covers Loop-powered collaborative meeting notes.
claims.quote: For non-channel Microsoft Teams meetings, collaborative meeting notes, including Loop-powered meeting notes and Facilitator notes

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope: Notes covered
claims.claim: The storage change covers Facilitator notes.
claims.quote: collaborative meeting notes, including Loop-powered meeting notes and Facilitator notes

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the change as providing more consistent ownership and management of meeting content.
claims.quote: This update provides more consistent ownership and management of meeting content while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is Rolling out.
claims.quote: "status": "Rolling out", "statusKey": "rolling-out"

claims.claim: The roadmap target is November CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "November CY2026"

claims.claim: The release phases are General Availability and Targeted Release.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Targeted Release"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant) and GCC.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)", "GCC"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap platforms are Android, Desktop, iOS, Mac and Web.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Android", "Desktop", "iOS", "Mac", "Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap gives no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.claim: The roadmap modification timestamp is 2026-11-11T00:51:09.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Scope; rationales
claims.claim: The new storage rule applies to newly created non-channel meeting notes.
claims.quote: For non-channel meetings, newly created collaborative meeting notes will be stored in the meeting organizer’s OneDrive for Business, in the Meetings folder.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: New notes are stored in the organiser's Meetings folder.
claims.quote: newly created collaborative meeting notes will be stored in the meeting organizer’s OneDrive for Business, in the Meetings folder.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The organiser owns the file even when another participant starts notes or Facilitator.
claims.quote: The organizer will own the notes file even when another participant starts notes or Facilitator.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Participants retain access to open and collaborate on notes in Teams, subject to existing sharing policies.
claims.quote: Participants can continue to open and collaborate on notes in Teams, subject to your organization’s existing sharing policies.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Existing notes stay in their current locations and are not moved.
claims.quote: Notes created before this change will remain in their current location; they will not be moved to the organizer’s OneDrive.

claims.claim: Channel meeting notes storage is unchanged.
claims.quote: Storage for channel meeting notes is not changing.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; controls[2].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: The notice says no configuration change is required for the storage update.
claims.quote: No configuration change is required for this storage update.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: Clouds and rollout; Governance guidance; changes[0]
claims.claim: The notice schedules Worldwide rollout to begin in mid-November 2026 and expects completion by late November 2026.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in mid-November 2026 and expect to complete by late November 2026.

claims.claim: The supplied notice sets no act-by date.
claims.quote: Act by: none

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft asks administrators to update guidance and governance processes that assume note-starter-owned storage.
claims.quote: Review any internal guidance or governance processes that assume meeting notes are stored in the OneDrive of the person who starts them, and update those processes to account for organizer-owned storage for newly created non-channel meeting notes.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft asks administrators to review data location and retention policies.
claims.quote: Review your organization’s data location and retention policies as appropriate.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The storage change arrives without administrator opt-in, so its default state is on.
claims.quote: We will begin rolling out in mid-November 2026 and expect to complete by late November 2026. No configuration change is required for this storage update.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The Loop storage page lists private meeting content in a user's OneDrive Meetings folder without naming the organiser.
claims.quote: Teams private meeting | | | ✔️in 📁`Meetings` | user account

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The Facilitator page still describes storage in the initiating user's OneDrive.
claims.quote: Facilitator data in meetings is stored as a `.loop` file in a OneDrive folder titled Meetings of the user who initiated Facilitator in Teams.

claims.claim: The cited Loop storage, Loop requirements and Facilitator pages do not yet describe the organiser-owned storage rule.
claims.quote: Searched: meeting notes organizer OneDrive storage location setting license; read loop-storage, loop-requirements and facilitator-teams in full. They give generic user storage or initiator storage, not the new organiser rule.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: OneDrive-hosted Loop content follows the standard OneDrive IT policy when its user leaves.
claims.quote: When content is stored in OneDrive, if that user leaves the organization, the standard OneDrive IT policy is applied.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters
claims.claim: Retention policies can target individual OneDrive accounts, so account scoping matters for the new file location.
claims.quote: To specify individual OneDrive accounts, see Get a list of all user OneDrive URLs in your organization.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters
claims.claim: eDiscovery holds preserve content in the selected OneDrive accounts, making the account holding the notes relevant.
claims.quote: Place a hold on the Exchange mailboxes and OneDrive accounts of people you're investigating in the case. When you place content locations on hold, you preserve content until you remove the content location from the hold

claims.claim: The SharePoint and OneDrive retention page marks Facilitator notes retention support as preview.
claims.quote: In preview, Microsoft Facilitator AI-generated notes in meetings are supported by retention policies and retention labels.

claims.claim: The Facilitator Purview page lists retention policies and labels for its meeting notes as supported.
claims.quote: For Facilitator AI-generated notes in meetings, use a retention policy or retention labels with the OneDrive accounts option.

claims.claim: Facilitator's AI-generated meeting notes do not inherit the meeting sensitivity label.
claims.quote: AI-generated notes for meetings don't inherit the meeting's sensitivity label; however, a sensitivity label can be applied to the notes' Loop component in the Loop app or OneDrive.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Security & identity
claims.claim: The notice describes a storage change, not a change to Facilitator actions or the participant note-taking experience.
claims.quote: This update provides more consistent ownership and management of meeting content while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.

claims.claim: The supplied roadmap and notice name no new licence, meter or charge for this storage change.
claims.quote: Searched: licence, license, meter, charge in the complete roadmap record and supplied MC1523076. Neither names a new charge or licence; the notice asks for guidance and governance review.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Loop components require a OneDrive or SharePoint licence.
claims.quote: Loop components license | OneDrive or SharePoint license; Users need a OneDrive or SharePoint license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Facilitator is included with a Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Facilitator is included with a Microsoft Copilot license and subject to available capacity.

claims.claim: Facilitator availability is subject to available capacity.
claims.quote: Facilitator is included with a Microsoft Copilot license and subject to available capacity.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope: Prerequisites
claims.claim: Initiating Facilitator requires an eligible Microsoft 365 base licence.
claims.quote: Users must meet all of the following requirements: Licensing requirements - An eligible Microsoft 365 base license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope: Prerequisites
claims.claim: Initiating Facilitator requires an eligible Microsoft Teams licence.
claims.quote: Have an eligible Microsoft Teams license.

claims.claim: Initiating Facilitator requires a Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Have a Microsoft Copilot license. Only licensed users can initiate Facilitator.

claims.claim: Facilitator must be allowed for the user who initiates it.
claims.quote: As an admin, you control whether Facilitator is available to your entire organization or to a certain group of users. To allow Facilitator for users, a new app policy needs to be created and then assigned to users.

claims.claim: Loop experiences in Teams must be turned on to use Facilitator in meetings.
claims.quote: Loop experiences in Teams need to be turned on in order for Facilitator to be used in meetings.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Storage; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Loop files stored in OneDrive and SharePoint follow those locations' storage quotas.
claims.quote: Loop files in their OneDrive and SharePoint locations follow the quotas of those storage locations.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No licence, price or meter specific to organiser-owned meeting-note storage is published in the checked Microsoft documentation.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams meeting notes organizer owned OneDrive storage licensing price meter configuration switch PowerShell; meeting notes organizer OneDrive storage location setting license. Read Loop requirements, storage, compliance summary and Facilitator licensing; no change-specific licence or meter.

claims.claim: The storage option is inside the existing licensed products, so licensing is included rather than unknown.
claims.quote: Facilitator is included with a Microsoft Copilot license and subject to available capacity.

claims.claim: A tenant-wide admin UI for the collaborative meeting notes SharePoint property is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: collaborative meeting notes admin center enable disable; Loop collaborative meeting notes IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin UI. Read Loop admin policies and Facilitator setup: the property is PowerShell; Cloud Policy covers New Calendar; the admin-center checkbox covers workspaces.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true enables collaborative meeting notes.
claims.quote: Teams channel meeting (Teams In Meeting experience and Teams Classic Calendar) | SharePoint property `Set-SPOTenant -IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled $true`

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled applies to the entire tenant.
claims.quote: This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled cannot be configured per user.
claims.quote: It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The SharePoint meeting-notes property does not govern notes created in Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: Managing Loop experiences in Teams requires the latest SharePoint PowerShell module.
claims.quote: You'll need the latest version of SharePoint PowerShell module to enable or disable Loop experiences in Teams.

claims.where: controls[2].ui, controls[2].api; controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no UI or API setting to choose between the organiser's and note-starter's OneDrive.
claims.quote: Searched: Loop collaborative meeting notes IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin UI storage organizer OneDrive choose location Set-SPOTenant; meeting notes organizer OneDrive storage location setting license. Read Loop policies, storage, Facilitator and Set-SPOTenant; no storage-choice setting.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Teams apps > Manage apps > Facilitator > Allow or Block reaches the app control.
claims.quote: In the left rail navigation, select Teams apps > Manage apps. In the apps list's search box, search for Facilitator. Select Facilitator from the app list. In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.claim: Update-M365TeamsApp -Id <app id> -IsBlocked <Boolean> changes the tenant app state.
claims.quote: This cmdlet updates app state and app available values for the Microsoft Teams app. -Id: Application ID of Microsoft Teams app. -IsBlocked: The state of the app in the tenant. Type: Boolean.

claims.claim: Facilitator is allowed by default.
claims.quote: Facilitator is allowed by default.

claims.claim: Facilitator is blocked when all apps are blocked for the organisation.
claims.quote: However, if all apps are blocked for your organization, Facilitator is also blocked.

claims.claim: The Update-M365TeamsApp reference describes both its $true and $false examples as unblocking.
claims.quote: Example 3: -IsBlocked $true. Unblocks Bookings app. Example 4: -IsBlocked $false. Unblocks 1Page App

claims.claim: Loop components in Teams, including meeting notes, are listed as available in commercial, GCC, GCC High and DoD environments.
claims.quote: Loop components in Teams (chat, channels, chat notes, meeting notes) | ✅ Available | ✅ Available; US government cloud environments (GCC, GCC High, DoD)

claims.claim: The creation-path table lists IsLoopEnabled for private meetings in the in-meeting experience and Classic Calendar.
claims.quote: Teams private meeting (Teams In Meeting experience and Teams Classic Calendar) | SharePoint property `Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true` | User's OneDrive: `Meetings` folder

claims.claim: The Facilitator page names IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled as the control for AI-generated meeting notes.
claims.quote: You can manage this control using the `IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled` setting in PowerShell. This setting applies to your entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: Create and view Loop files in Microsoft apps that support Loop applies to Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: Create and view Loop files in Microsoft apps that support Loop | Applies to: - Outlook integration - Teams New Calendar integration - OneNote integration - Whiteboard integration

claims.claim: Create and view Loop files in Outlook also applies to Teams New Calendar.
claims.quote: Create and view Loop files in Outlook | First checks Create and view Loop files in Microsoft apps that support Loop; then applies Create and view Loop files in Outlook, if applicable. Applies to: - Outlook - Teams New Calendar

claims.claim: Blocking the Facilitator app controls Facilitator rather than the separately governed creation of human-started Loop notes.
claims.quote: As an admin, you control whether Facilitator is available to your entire organization or to a certain group of users. In the actions menu, select Allow or Block.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Every control that the page tells readers to check is represented in its controls table.
claims.quote: Check that the retention policies, holds and eDiscovery collections you use for meeting content reach organisers' OneDrive locations; check both properties. The table contains only collaborative notes creation, Facilitator availability and the storage-choice gap.
claims.fix: The retention-policy, hold and eDiscovery-collection scoping checklist step has no corresponding row; replace it with 'Ask compliance owners to review the effect of organiser-owned storage on meeting-content governance, as MC1523076 recommends.' In Governance controls, remove 'so check both properties' because IsLoopEnabled has no row. Do not add control rows in this correction.

claims.claim: The existing note-taking and collaboration experience is preserved for meeting participants.
claims.quote: while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The supplied notice does not describe the mechanism that grants participants access to the organiser-owned notes file.
claims.quote: Searched: access, sharing, permissions in the complete supplied MC1523076. It says participants can continue to collaborate subject to existing sharing policies, but gives no access-granting mechanism.
